lines.t: I’ve been staring at the drywall, 4 AM again
Counting up the ways I tried to please a world of men
Chased the high, chased the gold, chased the temporary friends
Trying to find a medicine that never had to end
I got exactly what I wanted, but it didn’t do a thing
Just a heavier weight under a shiny silver ring
Turns out the more you feed the world, the hungrier you get
And the only thing it leaves you with is a pocket of regret
Yeah, I’ve been running till my heels are worn out to the sole
Trying to find a human hand to fill a God-sized hole...
And I'm tired of the run
[Chorus]
I just wanna love Somebody
Who won't leave a hole in my chest
Who don't only care when I'm looking my best
Yeah, I'm tired of the chase, tired of the same old game
Trading my peace for a little bit of fame
I've been falling apart, trying to make the world my home
But I need to love Somebody who won't ever let me go
Yeah, who won't ever let me go
I remember crying in the front seat of my car
Thinking that a bottle or a boy could heal a scar
But the hangover was cruel and the boys they always leave
And the mirrors don't lie about the things that you believe
I was so damn tired of pretending I was fine
Pouring out my soul for a drop of cheap wine
Till I fell down on my knees in the gravel and the dust
And I traded all my panic for a little bit of trust
Yeah, I was running till my heels were worn out to the sole
Trying to find a human hand to fill a God-sized hole...
And I'm tired of the run
[Chorus]
I just wanna love Somebody
Who won't leave a hole in my chest
Who don't only care when I'm looking my best
Yeah, I'm tired of the chase, tired of the same old game
Trading my peace for a little bit of fame
I've been falling apart, trying to make the world my home
But I need to love Somebody who won't ever let me go
[Bridge]
It’s a different kind of quiet when You whisper in the dark
You didn't ask for perfect, You just asked me for my heart
You didn't need a show, You didn't need a crowd
Just a broken-down sinner who was tired of being proud...
Yeah, I was so tired of being proud
[Chorus]
I just wanna love Somebody
Who won't leave a hole in my chest
Who don't only care when I'm looking my best
Yeah, I'm tired of the chase, tired of the same old game
Trading my peace for a little bit of fame
I've been falling apart, trying to make the world my home
But I need to love Somebody who won't ever let me go
Who won't ever let me go...
No, You don't let me go.
[Soft acoustic strumming, slow fade out]
